counties.name: Wake County, NC
counties.notes: Native SR 2264; outSR=4326 and f=geojson work. Geocoded points sit on the street centreline, so the address query must run first. Test: 1823 WHITE OAK RD returns two parcels (PIN 1704581656, 1704581587).

counties.name: Maricopa County, AZ
counties.notes: Native SR 3857. Point geometry MUST be sent as JSON ({x,y,spatialReference}); the lon,lat shorthand returns no features. Test: point -112.0740,33.4484 returns APN 11221086 (2 N CENTRAL AVE).
